release_conditions: Commit the exact reviewed candidate without content changes.
Build standalone MIND from the clean commit.
Publish main and the 2.0.6 release artifact.
Wait for CI and Pages success.
Recheck live repository, every Pages route, navigation, all three assets, Open Graph metadata, and latest release metadata.
Any post-review content change requires a new fingerprint and all three reviews.
residual_risk: Live publication is not yet observed and remains a mandatory gate.
